title: Doubt, Jealousy, and Projection
grammar: Psychological verbs and idiomatic case government (szembenéz, azonosul, belemerül, kivetít)
goal: I can use B2 psychological verbs with their mandatory case frames (szembenéz + -val/-vel, belemerül + -ba/-be, kivetít + -ra/-re)
I can discuss psychoanalytic concepts such as projection, repression, and confrontation in Hungarian
I can build complex sentences combining cataphoric pronouns (azzal néz szembe, hogy...) with psychological predicates
